text: At CloudWay 24, we recognize the dedication and hard work of our employees by offering exclusive travel privileges. Our employee travel benefits are tailored to provide both flexibility and exceptional value, across all cabin classes.
path: CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets & Discounts Policy

locations.heading: CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets & Discounts Policy

text:
All full-time CloudWay 24 employees are eligible for:
- 4 (four) round-trip international tickets per calendar year
  - These can be used by the employee or together for family travel
  - Employees may use all 4 round-trip tickets at once for family trips
path: CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets & Discounts Policy > 🎫 Employee Free Tickets Policy

text:
Ticket Details:
- Eligible routes: Any CloudWay 24 operated international route
- Validity: Tickets must be used within the calendar year; unused tickets will not roll-over
path: CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets & Discounts Policy > 🎫 Employee Free Tickets Policy

text:
Pilots and employees at Senior Management level and above are entitled to:
- Complimentary upgrade to CloudElite (Business Class) on their 4 annual free round-trip tickets
path: CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets & Discounts Policy > 🥇 Special Entitlement for Pilots & Senior Members

locations.heading: 🥇 Special Entitlement for Pilots & Senior Members
🥇 Special Entitlement for Pilots & Senior Members

text:
Additional Perks:
- Priority check-in and boarding
- Lounge access for themselves and accompanying family using free tickets
path: CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets & Discounts Policy > 🥇 Special Entitlement for Pilots & Senior Members

locations.heading: 🥇 Special Entitlement for Pilots & Senior Members
🥇 Special Entitlement for Pilots & Senior Members

text:
- Employees can opt to use all 4 round-trip tickets in one go for family travel (e.g., 1 trip with the employee + 3 family members)
- Family defined as: spouse, children, or dependent parents, as registered in HR records
path: CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets & Discounts Policy > 🚸 Family Travel Usage

text:
- Beyond the 4 free round trips, employees receive:
  - 50% discount on unlimited additional tickets (Economy Class)
  - Upgrades to higher cabin classes at special staff rates (subject to availability)
  - SkyPoints 24 loyalty program points are earned on discounted tickets (unless otherwise specified)
path: CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets & Discounts Policy > ✈️ Additional Travel Discounts

text:
- All bookings must be made via the CloudWay 24 Staff Portal.
- Free tickets are subject to seat availability and blackout dates may apply (e.g., major holiday periods).
- Tickets are non-transferable except for immediate family as per HR records.
- Taxes and surcharges (if any) to be borne by the employee.
- Abuse of staff travel privileges may result in disciplinary action.
path: CloudWay 24 Employee Free Tickets & Discounts Policy > 🚨 Terms & Conditions

text: For more details or to book your staff travel tickets, log in to the CloudWay 24 Staff Portal (https://cloudway24.com/staff).

text: Fly further with your CloudWay 24 family!
